Swap two numbers without using a third variable.

Supplied answer
a = int(input("Enter a: "))
b = int(input("Enter b: "))
a, b = b, a # tuple unpacking - the Pythonic way
print("After swapping: a =", a, ", b =", b)
Note: Interviewers also accept a = a + b; b = a - b; a = a - b. The tuple version is preferred.
